# Discord

An instant messaging and VoIP social platform.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/discord/.

## Actions

- **Get Invite**: Retrieve information about a specific invite code.
- **Get my guild member** (read-only): Retrieves the guild member object for the currently authenticated user within a specified guild, provided they are a member of that guild.
- **Get my OAuth2 authorization** (read-only): Retrieves current oauth2 authorization details for the application, including app info, scopes, token expiration, and user data…
- **Get my user** (read-only): Fetches comprehensive profile information for the currently authenticated discord user, including email if the 'email' scope is granted.
- **List my guilds** (read-only): Lists the current user's guilds, returning partial data for each.
- **Retrieve user connections** (read-only): Retrieves a list of the authenticated user's connected third-party accounts on discord.
